title: Assess exposure requested (Segment A trigger)
description: The message Pega sends to start Amendia Segment A (ach-exposure-assess): a held ACH exposure exception that needs a disposition recommendation. Author this schema in the onboarding wizard — it is the process trigger, not a tool output, so it cannot be introspected from the MCP server. The pack's triage rule matches on request_type == "AssessExposureRequested"; case_id is the cohort correlation key (cohort_membership.correlation_key). Field shapes match the mock Pega orchestrator's segment_a_payload.

case_id.description: Pega case id — the cohort correlation_value (one case per company per batch).
